body:
I can't reproduce it, tried with 100% and 200% editor scale.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/45fe9411-6d5c-413d-9dbe-7f5637a79bef)

Can you share the theme you used for testing?

Here's some better info on how to see the defects, all reproducible on 4.5dev and earlier. I'm including an MRP where you can see the defect even without MSAA enabled, by increasing Project Settings->display/window/stretch/scale to something like 4.0.

The defect only occurs with lines and highlight lines with odd pixel widths, because the current `Tree` code is not offsetting the draw `x` or `y` float values to center them inside the desired pixel centerline.

On a Mac hiDPI display, I don't think the editor blur with MSAA shows up, but definitely does on a non-hiDPI display. The defect at the corner bend of the highlight line shows up regardless of MSAA being enabled or not and also on hiDPI displays.

After changing the MSAA project setting, you have to quit the project and re-open to see the rendering difference.
